source.rights: Project-authored procedural kit; no external material incorporated; no new public license asserted.

uv_atlas.method: exact coincident crown-position weld, Blender Smart UV Project, weighted continuous cap islands, then one multi-object Pack Islands operation
uv_atlas.source_missing_uv_cause: Selected VariantA opaque source nodes lack UVs; crowns used repeated length/girth UVs. All retained surfaces were reprojected and globally packed.
uv_atlas.overlap_handling: all selected UV islands were passed together to Blender's multi-object Pack Islands operator
uv_atlas.transfer_key: node name + loop order; per-node input_uv_template.sha256_loop_order records the exact packed UV sequence

geometry_scope: Existing C# nonhero crown algorithm only. Original wall backing, roof, entry hall, opening reveals and joinery meshes retained; runtime-hidden corner posts excluded. Later TimberHomeStyle additions/material regrade are not claimed as extracted live state.
remaining: Parent construction decision required before any paid retexture. No API upload, generation, runtime promotion or native-performance claim.

construction_review.observed: Four actual exported-GLB views preserve the original roof, source apertures/reveals and regular courses. Corner closeup shows paired thin elliptic log ends and visible dark diamond-shaped voids between them, rather than a convincing cut/notched corner joint.
construction_review.causal_source: Existing nonhero runtime algorithm uses 0.09 m depth radius, height radius course*0.64, side-wall half-course offset and 0.18 m overhangs; it does not construct saddle/notch geometry. This donor reproduces that algorithm without inventing replacement logs.
construction_review.not_drop_in_runtime: Donor UVs are a new unique atlas and include runtime-generated crown nodes. Direct canonical replacement would require existing consumer integration to prevent duplicate runtime crown generation. No such integration is made here.

local_cleanup.open_file_check: lsof reported no holders before both removal batches
local_cleanup.retained: canonical source unchanged; final donor GLB/Blend, recipe, final four actual views, raw preparation logs and superseded inspection receipt retained
